fields.name: chakra
fields.description: Chakra name, case-insensitive (e.g., heart, Heart, HEART all work). Valid: Root, Sacral, Solar Plexus, Heart, Throat, Third Eye, Crown.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-30, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.
